test_decisions.scenario: Trusted publisher may see a temporarily stale PR head after successful git push. Exact parent, base, allowed changed files and postpublication terminal guard remain mandatory even after bounded retries.
test_decisions.requirement: R127-09 / R127-10: a robust trusted GitHub publication must remain fail-closed.

search.scope: Reused existing trusted publisher and full Git integration tests without introducing another publisher.

candidates.oracle: Two validated terminal guard executions, exact material parent and no unauthorized result paths.
candidates.comparison: Extend with stale-read success and permanent drift failures.

candidates.oracle: Existing forced staging must remain within the certificate allowlist.
candidates.comparison: Preserve prior staging regression; add authenticated readback behavior.

test_decisions.justification: A real trusted publisher run proved the exact failure; the existing harness faithfully records Git push, terminal guards and API reads.
